fields.feedback: What must the proposed specification change?
What must change in the replacement pull request?

pr_body.review_status: optional(enum(draft, ready, changes_requested, approved, merged, closed))

validate.message: The plan needs at least one case and one hypothesis.
Every slice id must be a case id.
The slice may hold at most the workflow's slice case limit.

validate.check: len(filter(plan.cases, item.is_control == true)) == 0 or len(filter(plan.cases, item.is_control == true and contains(plan.slice.case_ids, item.id))) > 0
validate.message: When any case is a control, the slice must include a control case.
The paid slice cap must be above zero and at most the workflow's slice cap.
Case ids must be unique.
A case may belong to only one group.
Groups may name only plan case ids.

validate.check: every(plan.cases, contains(map(plan.groups, item.id), item.group) and contains(require(lookup(plan.groups, id, item.group)).case_ids, item.id))
validate.message: Every case must be listed by the group it names.
Paid slice models must be plan models.
Group and hypothesis ids must be unique.
The assessment must name the latest slice report's run key.

validate.check: published(plan) and every(map(latest(plan).slice.criteria, item.id), contains(map(filter(slice_assessment.item_assessments, item.subject.kind == "criterion"), item.subject.id), item))
validate.message: Every slice criterion must be assessed.

validate.check: published(plan) and every(map(latest(plan).iteration_triggers, item.id), contains(map(filter(slice_assessment.item_assessments, item.subject.kind == "trigger"), item.subject.id), item))
validate.message: Every iteration trigger must be assessed.
Assessment item ids must be unique.
Additional finding ids must be unique.

validate.check: every(slice_assessment.next_actions, (item.source.kind == "item_assessment" and contains(map(slice_assessment.item_assessments, item.subject.id), item.source.id)) or (item.source.kind == "additional_finding" and contains(map(slice_assessment.additional_findings, item.id), item.source.id)))
validate.message: Every next action source must resolve to an assessed item or additional finding.

validate.check: (slice_assessment.verdict == "fail" and (len(filter(slice_assessment.item_assessments, item.status != "met")) > 0 or len(filter(slice_assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "blocking")) > 0)) or (slice_assessment.verdict == "pass_with_notes" and not (len(filter(slice_assessment.item_assessments, item.status != "met")) > 0 or len(filter(slice_assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "blocking")) > 0) and (len(filter(slice_assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "warning")) > 0)) or (slice_assessment.verdict == "pass" and not (len(filter(slice_assessment.item_assessments, item.status != "met")) > 0 or len(filter(slice_assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "blocking")) > 0) and not (len(filter(slice_assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "warning")) > 0))
validate.message: Assessment verdict must match item statuses and additional finding severities.

validate.check: slice_assessment.test_evidence.failed == 0 or (len(filter(slice_assessment.item_assessments, item.status != "met")) > 0 or len(filter(slice_assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "blocking")) > 0) or (len(filter(slice_assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "warning")) > 0)
validate.message: Failed tests require an unmet item or a blocking or warning additional finding.

validate.check: published(plan) and every(slice_build.case_ids, contains(latest(plan).slice.case_ids, item)) and every(latest(plan).slice.case_ids, contains(slice_build.case_ids, item))
validate.message: The slice build must cover exactly the plan's slice cases.
Every slice case needs a qualification result.
The slice build's cohort_id is slice.
The generator digest is required.
No paid results yet: this offline report waits for the spend request's approval.
Paid results need an approved spend request.

validate.check: published(plan) and every(map(latest(plan).slice.criteria, item.id), contains(map(slice_report.criteria_marks, item.id), item))
validate.message: Every plan slice criterion must be marked.

validate.check: published(plan) and every(map(latest(plan).iteration_triggers, item.id), contains(map(slice_report.trigger_marks, item.id), item))
validate.message: Every plan iteration trigger must be marked.

validate.check: published(plan) and every(map(slice_report.qualifications, item.case_id), contains(latest(plan).slice.case_ids, item)) and every(latest(plan).slice.case_ids, contains(map(slice_report.qualifications, item.case_id), item))
validate.message: The report's case ids must equal the plan's slice ids.
Paid results may name only slice cases.
The report's generator digest must equal the latest slice build's.
A paid report needs its run key (the paid run's store path).
The spend request's generator digest must equal the latest slice build's.

validate.check: published(slice_build) and every(spend_request.case_ids, contains(latest(slice_build).case_ids, item)) and every(latest(slice_build).case_ids, contains(spend_request.case_ids, item))
validate.message: The spend request's case ids must equal the latest slice build's.

validate.check: spend_request.attempt_count > 0 and spend_request.cap_cents > 0 and published(plan) and spend_request.cap_cents <= latest(plan).slice_paid.cap_cents
validate.message: The spend request needs attempts and a cap within the plan's paid slice cap.

design.done_when: approved(plan) and approved(slice_report) and published(slice_build) and pr_published and (merged_pr or approved(pr))

let.observed_state_current: published(pr) and published(observed_state) and latest(observed_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url
let.pr_state_current: published(pr) and published(pr_state) and latest(pr_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url

outcome.cohort: {repository_key: input.repository.key, pr_url: latest(pr).pr_url, branch: latest(pr).branch, build_result: latest(slice_build).build}

merge_confirmation.when: pr_published and approved(slice_report) and not merged_pr and not approved(pr)

fields.feedback: What must the slice builder fix?

slice_report_review.when: report_is_paid and published(slice_assessment) and latest(slice_assessment).run_key == latest(slice_report).run_key

fields.feedback: What must the spend request change?

slice_builder.when: approved(plan) and not (report_is_placeholder and not approved(spend_request) and not changes_requested(spend_request))

Every allocated case must be assessed.
Assessment head_sha must match the latest expansion build.
Assessment item ids must be unique.
Additional finding ids must be unique.

validate.message: Every next action source must resolve to an assessed item or additional finding.

validate.message: Assessment verdict must match item statuses and additional finding severities.

validate.check: assessment.test_evidence.failed == 0 or (len(filter(assessment.item_assessments, item.status != "met")) > 0 or len(filter(assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "blocking")) > 0) or (len(filter(assessment.additional_findings, item.severity == "warning")) > 0)
validate.message: Failed tests require an unmet item or a blocking or warning additional finding.
The expansion's generator digest must equal the approved slice's.

validate.check: unique(expansion.case_ids) and every(expansion.case_ids, contains(input.case_ids, item)) and every(input.case_ids, contains(expansion.case_ids, item))
validate.message: The expansion's case ids must be exactly its allocated cases.
Every allocated case needs a qualification result.
The expansion's cohort_id is its group id.

expand.done_when: approved(assessment) and published(expansion) and pr_published and (merged_pr or approved(pr))

let.observed_state_current: published(pr) and published(observed_state) and latest(observed_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url
let.pr_state_current: published(pr) and published(pr_state) and latest(pr_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url

merge_confirmation.when: pr_published and approved(assessment) and not merged_pr and not approved(pr)

The freeze's cohort_id is freeze.

freeze.done_when: approved(freeze) and pr_published and (merged_pr or approved(pr))

let.observed_state_current: published(pr) and published(observed_state) and latest(observed_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url
let.pr_state_current: published(pr) and published(pr_state) and latest(pr_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url

merge_confirmation.when: pr_published and approved(freeze) and not merged_pr and not approved(pr)

validate.check: every(assessment.next_actions, (item.source.kind == "item_assessment" and contains(map(assessment.item_assessments, item.subject.id), item.source.id)) or (item.source.kind == "additional_finding" and contains(map(assessment.additional_findings, item.id), item.source.id)))
validate.message: Every next action source must resolve to an assessed item or additional finding.

integration.done_when: approved(assessment) and pr_published and (approved(manual_merge_target) or (observed_state_current and (latest(observed_state).state == "merged" or (input.final_merge_policy == "allow_close_without_merge" and latest(observed_state).state == "closed_unmerged"))))

let.observed_state_current: published(pr) and published(observed_state) and latest(observed_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url
let.pr_state_current: published(pr) and published(pr_state) and latest(pr_state).url == latest(pr).pr_url

merge_confirmation.when: published(manual_merge_target) and not final_state and not closed_pr and not approved(manual_merge_target)
